title: HUB BAZAAR (Tarab Drill × Mediterranean House) [105]
style: Middle Eastern tarab meets UK drill and Mediterranean house, 105 BPM with half-time drill feel, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), trilingual chop weave Arabic + Greek + te reo Maori, oud melody phrases, qanun plucks, darbuka and riq rolls, drill-style sliding 808 sub bass, sparse drill hi-hats with triplet rolls, bouzouki countermelody, ney flute accents, female chops pitched +6 and male chops at -3, golden-spice-bazaar-night mood, sidechain ducking pads to kick, club world-fusion 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(oud melody, ney flute, distant darbuka)
(HUB... ba... zaar...)
(yal... la... yal... la...)
(éla... éla... éla...)

[Build]
(darbuka roll locks in, 808 sub slides up)
HUB! BA — ZAAR!
YAL — LA! YAL — LA!
É — LA! É — LA!
KEEL — CLEAR — GO!
(qanun pluck climb, riq shake)

[Drop 1]
(half-time drill kick, sliding 808, oud lead)
HUB — BA — ZAAR!
GATE — OPEN!
MEET — ME!
HA — BIBI!
(chop stack +7) yalla-yalla-éla-éla / āe-āe-yalla-yalla
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(bouzouki countermelody, chops trade left-right)
(wein?) (pou?) (kei hea?)
(hena!) (edo!) (konei!)
(habibi!) (agapi mou!) (e hoa!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE GATE —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to oud + ney flute, no drums)
(whispered) hub... bazaar...
(soft) yalla... yalla...
(soft) éla... éla...
(piano lifts, soft chop)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(darbuka roll builds, drill kick returns)

[Drop 2]
(double-time drill, full tarab stack peak)
HUB — BA — ZAAR! (yalla yalla yalla!)
GATE — OPEN! (éla éla éla!)
HA — BIBI! (agapi mou! e hoa!)
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(darbuka fades, oud resolves)
(hub... bazaar...)
(yalla... éla...)
(habibi... e hoa...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(ney flute holds and fades)
